image_description: A close-up, slightly low-resolution image showing a cluster of three to four small hamsters huddled together in a nest made of shredded white paper and grey stones. The background is a solid blue wall. The hamsters appear to be golden or cream-colored with pinkish skin visible on their ears and faces. One hamster on the left is facing forward, one in the center is partially obscured, and one on the right shows its back/rear.

The eyes on the visible hamster (left) are extremely faint, appearing as mere shadows or smudges rather than distinct, small dark orbs. They lack the necessary contrast and definition.
The ears on the central and left hamsters are visible, rounded, and proportionally large relative to the head, matching the description.

The rear of the rightmost hamster is visible, but the tail area is blurred and merges with the bedding. It is impossible to definitively identify a 'stubby tail' structure distinct from the fur and background.

It appears smooth, waxy, or melted, particularly on the back of the right hamster where it blends into the background without clear edge definition. This is a common AI artifact where texture fails to resolve at high frequency.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundaries between the two hamsters in the center-left are soft and ill-defined. Their fur seems to merge slightly, lacking the crisp separation expected from two distinct physical bodies pressing against each other.
The facial features (eyes, nose, mouth) are structurally vague. The snout area melts into the cheek without clear anatomical landmarks, making the face look distorted or incomplete.

The grey stones in the foreground have inconsistent lighting and shading. Some appear flat or painted on, lacking the volumetric depth and sharp edges of real rocks, contributing to a 'dreamlike' or unstable ground plane.
